title: Siren Head
blurb: The Siren Head sound — the distorted emergency-broadcast wail of the internet's favorite lanky cryptid. Trevor Henderson's creation speaks in corrupted siren tones, and this audio is its voice: wrong in a way that raises neck hair. Play it in the woods at your own risk, or use it for horror edits and ruining camping trips.
origin: The signature wail of Trevor Henderson's Siren Head cryptid.
